text: The initial tests for blood counts and inflammation markers came back normal, which is interesting given your severe leg pain and bruising. Have you noticed any swelling in your legs or any changes in your vision recently? REQUEST IMAGES: MRI_Pelvis_and_Femur

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal blood work and inflammation markers make acute leukemia less likely, despite the severe symptoms. Can you describe what the leg pain feels like—is it deep and constant, or is it sharp and triggered by movement? Have you noticed any swelling in your joints or any visual changes like seeing "floats" or blurred vision? REQUEST IMAGES: MRI_Pelvis_and_Femur

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and easy bruising. I also have Fever, Severe leg pain that disturbs sleep.

speaker: Doctor
text: I have requested the MRI images for your pelvis and femurs to look for an underlying bone issue; can you tell me if the leg pain feels worse when you try to move your legs, and have you noticed any new bruises on your hands or arms? Also, do you or your parents notice any gum swelling or changes in your gums?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Unremarkable past medical history. Social history: Attends preschool. Lives with parents and one younger sibling.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is good to know; given your fever, bruising, and severe bone pain with normal blood counts, we need to rule out osteomyelitis or bone tumors. Do you have a history of any recent cuts, insect bites, or infections on your legs?

speaker: Patient
text: Positive for fever, bruising, and bone pain. Denies cough, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, or urinary symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since you deny cough, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, or urinary symptoms, and your blood work was normal, this makes a systemic infection like meningococcemia or leukemia less likely. I need to see the MRI images I requested to check for bone marrow edema or a structural lesion in your legs. REQUEST IMAGES: MRI_Pelvis_and_Femur
